protocol.scope: Images/labels already on GPU; excludes input disk/PIL, startup, ADM/Inception and all metrics. Includes CPU launch overhead.
protocol.wallclock: CUDA synchronized wall-clock; components and independent end-to-end are separate passes, alternating pass order.
protocol.counted_FLOPs: PyTorch FlopCounterMode; supported convolution/matmul/attention, 2 FLOPs per MAC. Operator-level count stored.
protocol.FLOPs_limitations: Normalization, nonlinearities, sorting, thresholding, sampling, transfer and other unsupported operations may not be counted. Zero counted FLOPs does not mean zero computational cost.
protocol.FLOPs_input_scope: One representative input index0 per budget; its K is reported separately from latency sample mean and actual full50k distributions.
protocol.comparison: MixTok arXiv Appendix A.8 protocol: class 207, seeds 4..53, one RTX 5090, batch 1, 10 warmups, 50 measurements, median, TF32 enabled, cuDNN benchmarking.

router.policy: one forward, scalar U shift, fixed threshold count, stable top K

one_d_audit.type1_note: source row is unused by upstream 1D; not pretrained for 2D

pipeline.precision: BF16 stage1/stage2/adapter; FP32 adapter expansion; separate BF16 router expansion; FP32 scorer/projection/decoder; TF32off
pipeline.additional_models_at_inference: None; no B0, DINO, LPIPS, Inception or quality evaluator
pipeline.inputs: Batch1, ImageNet class207, torch seeds4..53; arXiv A.8 timing cohort, not the full50k quality batch plan
pipeline.endpoint_scope: Frozen checkpoint fixed-K diagnostics retain routing/adapter/both expansions; no optimized K0 bypass
pipeline.inference_policy: current learned dynamic or specified fixed-K diagnostic

final_frozen_audit.checkpoint_restore_scope: Strict stage2 model state at step20000, strict exported student state, hash-checked frozen adapter and official codec/stage1 assets. No optimizer restore: profiling performs no training.
